HeishaMon

History

Loading…
Charts are read from persistent SD-card CSV history. Select a period of up to 90 days; the display is downsampled without averaging COP values. Hover over a line to inspect its time and value. Drag across a chart to zoom all charts into that time range.

DHW

Tank setpoint and actual tank temperature are shown continuously. Inlet and outlet are assigned to DHW while the three-way valve is in the DHW position.

Heat

Inlet and outlet are assigned to heating while the three-way valve is in the Heat position. The main water setpoint remains visible for context.

Room temperature

Zone 1 room setpoint, actual Zone 1 temperature and outside temperature. The setpoint is supplied by the Zone 1 request when it represents a room target.

Zone 1 heating request

Heating curve shift (K) and heating water target (°C) remain separate from room temperatures because they describe the heating controller. Room-target requests are shown above as the Zone 1 room setpoint.

Compressor / hydraulics

The series use their native units: Hz, l/min and kW.

Efficiency / COP

COP Heat and COP DHW are calculated separately from the corresponding Panasonic production and consumption values. Aggregated period COP uses energy totals, not averaged COP samples.

Energy (kW)

Instantaneous Panasonic production and consumption values. Internal heater is a relay state (0/1), not measured power.

Heating demand & energy use

Daily demand — last 31 days

Heating degree days (K·d) use a configurable reference of 18.0 °C. Heat and DHW show electrical energy consumption in kWh.

Hourly demand — last 24 hours

The weather value is the hourly heating degree difference (K), not a degree day. Heat and DHW show electrical energy consumption per hour in kWh.

Energy statistics

Monthly production

Thermal energy in kWh for the last 12 calendar months.

Monthly COP

COP from monthly thermal and electrical energy totals.

Yearly production

Thermal energy in kWh, grouped by calendar year.

Yearly COP

COP from yearly thermal and electrical energy totals.

Storage settings

Loading…
Storage interval

How often a history sample is stored in RAM and on the SD card.

SD retention

Automatically removes old history and event CSV files. Unlimited uses the available SD-card space.

Electrical power source

Used for the estimated COP. Keep Panasonic selected unless an external MQTT power meter has been configured.
